requirement: This code is intended to implement dual-axis power control and readiness monitoring for two axes with error handling.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_DualAxisPower
VAR_INPUT
	Axis1			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;		//轴1引用
	Axis2			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;		//轴2引用
	bEnable			:	BOOL := TRUE;	//使能信号
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bAxis1Ready		:	BOOL;			//轴1准备就绪
	bAxis2Ready		:	BOOL;			//轴2准备就绪
	bBothReady		:	BOOL;			//两轴都准备就绪
	bError			:	BOOL;			//错误标志
END_VAR
